description: Repository audit for the minimum-production-hardening packet. Every place that assumed a manual/detached-python start, no auto-restart, no health probe, an optional :8791, or that an unsupervised listener reads healthy — classified Correct / Outdated-fix / Historical-preserve / Needs-governance. This is a DESIGN audit; no host or config is changed.

classes.Correct: the statement is accurate under this packet — no change needed
classes.Outdated-fix: the statement was wrong/stale and was corrected in THIS packet
classes.Historical-preserve: an accurate record of a PAST state (e.g. the DARK install-only profile) — kept verbatim, superseded not rewritten (RULE 5)
classes.Needs-governance: correct engineering but the LIVE change is Sponsor-gated (host/backend deploy) — flagged, not applied

findings.assumption: production runs ONLY under the GuvFXBetaAgent WinSW service; a bare `python agent.py` is OFFLINE/dev only and is the 2026-08-05 vector
findings.note: corrected in PR #291 WS-I; this packet ADDS the runtime enforcement (classify_launch + agent_supervised + optional refuse-to-bind) that makes the docstring's rule mechanically true, not just documented.

findings.assumption: startmode Manual, onfailure=none, registered STOPPED (nothing auto-restarts)
findings.note: accurate record of the DARK install-only state. NOT edited. Superseded by GuvFXBetaAgent.supervised.xml (the target); the switch is a Sponsor-gated deploy step.

findings.assumption: (new) Automatic+delayed, bounded-backoff restart floor, launch markers, refuse-switch default OFF
findings.note: the reviewable TARGET config. Applying it is a Windows-host mutation — NOT done here.
extended to advertise agent_supervised (bool) so a probe can distinguish a supervised listener from a bare launch. Byte-identical backend copy re-synced; manifest re-pinned.

findings.assumption: the only management call is per-job provisioning; there is no periodic liveness probe
findings.note: agent_health_probe.py adds a signed-NEGOTIATE readiness probe (read-only, no mutation) reusing this client. The probe is code+tests only; SCHEDULING it is a backend-deploy step (Needs-governance).

findings.assumption: a transport timeout is AMBIGUOUS and mapped to ManagementChannelTimeout (connect and read indistinguishable)
findings.note: the probe implements its OWN connect/read split locally (main lacks PR #290's transport-taxonomy split). The provisioning path is untouched. If #290 merges, reconcile the two split implementations.

findings.assumption: no supervision / no probe / no lifecycle log / unenforced launch / no alert delivery
findings.note: this packet IMPLEMENTS the minimum-for-beta set (RR-1/2/3/4/11) as repository engineering. The review remains the authoritative gap list; items stay open until the Sponsor-gated deploy.
now backed by real code (probe surfaces supervised; evaluate_alerts fires agent_unsupervised_listener → unsupervised-listener runbook).

findings.assumption: operational text describing the agent lifecycle
findings.note: PR #291 WS-I corrected the ':8791 SPOF' and 'never executed on a host' statements; this packet does not re-open them.

findings.assumption: config.load_config maps only the existing env set
findings.note: deliberately NOT edited. The refuse switch + launch markers are read from os.environ directly by AgentServer/classify_launch, and lifecycle paths are derived from log_dir/state_db — so the integrity-pinned bind-guard config is untouched.

findings.assumption: the OS bind is the hard single-instance backstop
findings.note: ADVERSARIAL fold-in 2026-08-06: the server inherited allow_reuse_address=True (SO_REUSEADDR), which on Windows permits a 2nd process to hijack :8791 — so the claim was FALSE on the target OS. Fixed to allow_reuse_address=False + SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE (exclusive bind); the single-instance lock is now advisory and never vetoes a start; an abnormal serve-thread death emits AGENT_CRASHED + non-zero exit so WinSW restarts.

not_changed: the provisioning transport (beta_worker make_http_transport / mgmt_client provisioning ops)
:8788 trade bridge, wayond listener, shadow worker, Customer Zero #12, live account #1
